title: Nvidia's role as AI financier faces first big test as neoclouds take market hit
script:
Nvidia's role as an AI financier is hitting a major market wall.
Neocloud firms built their entire business model on renting out Nvidia hardware.
Shares for some major players in this sector are down thirty percent this month.
CEO Jensen Huang has championed these firms as essential for massive AI infrastructure.
These companies now face intense pressure to prove they can generate consistent, long-term profits.
Without clear returns, investors are pulling capital away from these niche providers.
Is this AI infrastructure boom actually built on shaky financial ground?
